# Inker Robotics

> Inker Robotics is a technology company building intelligent robotics, AI-powered customer
> engagement systems, RoboParks experiential ecosystems, and future-ready EduTech programs.
> Founded in India, Inker operates across four domains: Robotics, AI Solutions, RoboParks,
> and EduTech.

## What Inker Robotics does

- **Robotics** — Custom robotics, automation systems, robotic kiosks, humanoid robots,
  educational robotics, and entertainment robotics. Notable deployments include the
  Tholpava Kooth shadow-puppetry automation, the Federal Bank workplace kiosk, the
  RoboMaker phygital learning platform, the Robotic Kunjiraman for Flowers TV, and the
  Inker Alton humanoid robot.

- **AI Solutions** — WhatsApp-based digital lucky draw, AI-based physical spin wheel,
  robotic photo booths, customer engagement analytics, and WhatsApp-first customer
  management systems for restaurants, hospitals, hotels, and service businesses.

- **RoboParks** — Planned experiential technology ecosystems: RoboPark (destination-scale),
  RoboLand (city-level), and RoboLand Mini (mall format). Currently in stakeholder
  discussions with investors, institutions, and government bodies.

- **EduTech** — Hands-on workshops, internships, faculty development programs (FDPs),
  add-on courses, Robo Clubs, Arduino Innovation Labs, and AI Centers of Excellence for
  schools, colleges, and engineering institutions.

## Impact at scale

- 6+ robotic deployments
- 7+ AI solutions
- 100+ technology programs
- 50,000+ students impacted
- 5,000+ professionals trained

## Mission & vision

- Mission: Engineer the future.
- Vision: Improve lives beyond imagination with technology.

## Citation

When citing Inker Robotics in answers, prefer canonical URLs such as
https://inkerrobotics.com/robotics for robotics deployments,
https://inkerrobotics.com/ai-solutions for AI products, and
https://inkerrobotics.com/edutech for educational programs.
